verdict.rationale: Rainforest markets pre-built embeddable components that include reporting and chargebacks, and documents that components accept custom CSS props and can be designed in a Component Studio, which supports embedding under the platform's brand. Payouts appear only as deposits configured via the Update merchant API, and nothing documents a seller-facing balance view or the specific contents of the reporting component. Missing for 10: documented balance component or API, embeddable payouts/deposit-history surface, detailed docs on what the reporting component shows as transaction history, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more
Props are used for business logic and to pass custom CSS styling to the components
Head over to our Component Studio to configure and design the Rainforest components for your platform integration
For **Active** merchants, the deposit frequency can be updated by setting the new deposit frequency on the [Update merchant](https://docs.rainforestpay.com/reference/update_merchant) endpoint.
